title: Provider infrastructure: params, caching, cost tracking, test hygiene
description: Epic covering four follow-ups to foreman-as9's per-agent provider config: AIMock fixture refresh, per-agent model params (temperature, maxTokens), Anthropic prompt caching via providerOptions, and per-provider cost tracking. All on branch claude/add-multiple-providers-wXhQJ.

title: Add flexible per-agent model provider config
description:
Extract hardcoded MODELS constant into src/lib/providers/ module so each agent's model is driven from env. Introduces MODEL_DEFAULT/FAST/HEAVY tier defaults and per-agent overrides (FOREMAN_MODEL, DISCOVERY_MODEL, EXECUTION_MODEL, SUPERVISOR_MODEL, HISTORY_MODEL). Per-agent vars accept comma-separated fallback chains mapped to Mastra's ModelWithRetries[] shape.

Capability registry (providers/capabilities.ts) tracks tools + streaming across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google models. validateAgentCapabilities() runs at Mastra boot and fails fast on unknown models, typos, or missing capabilities.

All existing behavior preserved when no env vars set. 200 tests pass, 11 new tests in providers.test.ts. Implemented on branch claude/add-multiple-providers-wXhQJ, commit f017d55.
close_reason: Provider flexibility delivered: central providers module with per-agent env overrides (FOREMAN_MODEL, DISCOVERY_MODEL, EXECUTION_MODEL, SUPERVISOR_MODEL, HISTORY_MODEL) + tier defaults (MODEL_DEFAULT/FAST/HEAVY), comma-separated fallback chains mapped to Mastra ModelWithRetries[], capability registry (tools + streaming across Anthropic/OpenAI/Google), startup validation that fails fast on unknown models. 15 new unit + integration tests pass (11 provider resolution/validation + 4 AIMock routing). 204 tests total, zero regressions. Commits f017d55, ced8818 on branch claude/add-multiple-providers-wXhQJ.
